transport.writes: MCP JSON-RPC tools/call with idempotency keys

invariants: The browser never receives database credentials.
The browser never selects its actor, tenant, sponsor, or authority class.
A refused write and an unanswered write remain distinct states.
Retries reuse the same idempotency key and reconcile against CARR.
Fixture data is synthetic and cannot become production state.
One logical operation carries one idempotency key across double click, reconnect and a second device; a re-send under that key replays the stored answer instead of writing again.
The sentence a partner types is sent verbatim as human_quote, or not at all; the app never composes one.
Property evidence v1 is a read-only, tenant-bound response; every fact carries its own source and temporal review state, and absent authoritative coverage remains unknown or unavailable.

response.coverage: Each current owner has one source. Missing scheduler observations remain unknown; the retired control-plane owner is absent.

response.evidence_coverage: Installation counts only; no deal or meeting index.

response.thread_metadata: Opaque JSON object. Store enforces related relevance, forbids raw content and returns metadata only; no subject/body/attachment bytes.
response.identity_source: Use only native identity already recorded on the deal activity; this verb does not discover threads by deal.

read-assurance-health.coverage: One exact workflow/version, optionally one work request. No global backup or supervisor/job health. The pinned read passes unavailable workflow truth and therefore returns unknown, unavailable, green false.

response.evidence_date: Original event occurred_at; phase-change occurrence date when the writer supplied no earlier evidence date.
response.undo: revert-deal-field with exact event_id; latest-field guard and idempotency key apply.

closed_deals.membership: Recorded won outcome, or no outcome with a recorded close/invoice date. Lost and paused outcomes are excluded; same workspace and account scope.
closed_deals.order: Close date descending, missing dates last, then name and id.

lost_deals.membership: Recorded lost outcome, independent of phase. Same workspace and account scope.

prospect_engagement_status.presentation: Only active prospects appear on the deal board. Inactive prospects return to the existing Leads pipeline.

phase_started_on.shape: object keyed by phase slug; YYYY-MM-DD values
phase_started_on.source: First event occurred_at per phase, in America/Chicago. A revisit does not replace the first start. Missing evidence has no key.

vendors.shape: Array of explicit active deal-vendor assignments; empty array when none. No assignments inferred from introductions or deal participants.
vendors.role: Specific service-role slug, displayed with underscores replaced by spaces.
vendors.order: Role, company name, contact name, vendor party id.

response.short_name: Record-layer short deal name; fall back to the actual deal name when contact or market evidence is absent.

open_actions.membership: Up to three open unstructured actions.
open_actions.order: Due date ascending, missing dates last, then id.

last_step.source: Newest recorded activity or completed action, ordered by occurred_at descending then id descending. Never inferred from last_touch.

response.client_id: Exact client record UUID, including closed and invoiced records; use for the authenticated clients record read.
response.client_portal_url: https://share.doctorcre.com/<slug> for the deal's active, non-disabled client portal; null otherwise. Derived at read time; never carries a password or hash.

phase_started_on.shape: object keyed by phase slug; YYYY-MM-DD values
phase_started_on.source: First event occurred_at per phase, in America/Chicago. A revisit does not replace the first start. Missing evidence has no key.

vendors.shape: Current detail returns an array of explicit active assignments; empty array when none. The archived-detail fallback may omit this field.
vendors.role: Specific service-role slug, displayed with underscores replaced by spaces.
vendors.order: Role, company name, contact name, vendor party id.

next_actions.hold_until: YYYY-MM-DD or null. An open action is held while hold_until is later than the current calendar date. Held actions remain in this history read. Accepted post-call actions return null.

response.short_name: Record-layer short deal name; fall back to the actual deal name when contact or market evidence is absent.

email_threads.shape: Optional array of {conversation_id, subject, latest_message_at}, newest message first; conversation_id and subject may be null. Missing on older servers.
email_threads.source: DoctorCRE/carr-system PR #2694 at b36239232aca073d062530d23f74e4aed40dd760: subject is outside-origin email_context.subject; latest_message_at is the latest email activity occurred_at.

checklist.source_of_truth: CARR doctrine sections, with runtime content-hash validation; the app renders producer items and statuses.
checklist.due_basis: Only open, sourced critical_date records. No legal or payment deadline is inferred.
checklist.first_slice: Current lease, expiration, invoice and full commission receipt derive completion. Unlinked documents and lifecycle LOI records remain not_recorded.
checklist.unavailable: Missing checklist storage returns no phases or due items; retain deal detail and its update form. Retry storage on each read.

list-feature-switches.availability: CARR evaluates the authenticated actor; the app consumes available === true and never evaluates audiences.

response.membership: Active deals without a closed phase, outcome, close date or invoice date. Includes both owners and national accounts. Open actions retain hold dates; Home applies Chicago business dates and owner scope.
response.overflow: agenda_limit_exceeded; no truncated or partial snapshot is returned.
response.short_name: Record-layer short deal name; fall back to the actual deal name when contact or market evidence is absent.

response.membership: Pending proposals in unexpired distilling post-call sessions for active board deals. Ordered by created_at, then id.
response.overflow: post_call_followups_limit_exceeded; no partial snapshot is returned.

read-post-call-followups.home_slice: Home preserves assigned task controls and shows pending email subject, recipient reference and deal in Team view. Review draft opens the exact call session in local Call Mode; email approval and draft creation remain there.
read-post-call-followups.resolution: Existing resolve-post-call-candidate records an assigned action or skips one proposal. It does not perform the described action. Email resolution confirms only metadata and a local body hash; it creates no email or Outlook draft.

read-client-portal.projection: One password-bound portal, canonical roadmap and explicitly shared text material only.
read-client-portal.password_lifetime: Form and request memory only. Never URL, storage, diagnostic output or Doc context.
read-client-portal.deployment_order: Server must be live before the app consumer merges or deploys. Public client hosting remains separate.

calendar-meeting-prep.audience: Authenticated partner only; no caller-selected sponsor or tenant.
calendar-meeting-prep.response: Calendar section with state ready, empty, partial or unavailable; items, notes, observed_at and sources. Each item has start, end, title, location, all_day, schedule_conflict, time_changed and possible_deals. Each possible deal has id, name, client_ref and prep.
calendar-meeting-prep.preparation: prep.state is ready or unavailable. Ready preparation supplies nullable phase, next_step, next_date, last_touch and market. Missing preparation never hides the meeting or its possible deal link.
calendar-meeting-prep.match_basis: Exact attendee email is a possible match, never a confirmed meeting-to-deal relationship. Display suggestions as unconfirmed. Failed deal_suggestions is unavailable, never proof of no related deal.
calendar-meeting-prep.presentation: On-demand Home dialog. Render calendar notes including zero-row partial responses, source freshness, unavailable states and retry. No startup read or writes. Clear content and reject late results on close, disposal or session invalidation.

system_work_inventory.ordering: opened_at ascending, kind and id in C text order; Live library last_activity_at descending
system_work_inventory.cache: GitHub comes from published producer cache; no GitHub requests per page load

connections.missing_observations: Unknown status and unavailable spend; configuration and capacity do not imply authenticated capability or currency charges.

pagination.correspondence_cursor: Optional exact next_cursor object with occurred_at and id from correspondence_page
pagination.stage_history_cursor: Optional exact next_cursor mutation_order string from stage_history_page
pagination.response: Independent correspondence_page and stage_history_page each contain total, has_more, and next_cursor. Append only the requested history array.
pagination.ordering: Correspondence by occurred_at then id descending. Stage history by mutation_order descending.

writes.stage: update-lead (base_version, stage_review evidence IDs, same idempotency key on retry)
writes.undo: update-lead (latest exact undo_event_id and prior stage)
writes.claim: claim-lead (authenticated human, unowned New, exact base_version)
writes.link: link-lead-client (exact client_id, confirmed human choice, exact base_version)
writes.engagement: set-prospect-engagement-status (client_id, client base_version, active or inactive, reason, expected_actor, same idempotency key on retry)

coverage.correspondence: captured_entries_only; zero captures do not imply zero communication; Details exposes stored original entry
coverage.search_run: last_search_at null until CARR has an authoritative new-lead search completion field
coverage.scores: existing record score; null shown as missing

lead_workspace.prospect_lifecycle: Inactive prospects remain eligible Leads despite retained exact client and deal links. Active prospects return to the existing deal board.

invoice_tracker.payment: Full receipt of one commission; dated and version guarded

morning_brief.overnight_read: GET /pipeline/changes; initial base64url JSON keyset cursor {recorded_at: ISO cutoff, id: zero UUID}; subsequent opaque cursors are server-issued; only brief-authorized deal IDs render

calendar.rows: items with start, title, location, attendee_count and all_day; server order retained
calendar.warnings: Render notes plainly, including partial responses with no rows. An omitted section is not an empty calendar.

queue_reads.arguments: queue and opaque cursor only; authenticated sponsor
queue_reads.coverage: total, returned, remaining when supplied, has_more, next_cursor; partial totals cover available sources only
queue_reads.consistency: live urgency keyset; restart after changed rows; not a snapshot

coverage.required_sections: Needs Joe for Joe only; all other sections for both sponsors. Missing sections are unavailable. Expandable sections retain all returned items, accounts and providers.
coverage.incomplete_sources: Safe category and state only; no driver diagnostics.

morning_brief.overnight_cutoff: Previous Chicago calendar day at 17:00 when no saved briefing window exists; date-only fields retain their calendar date.

progress_board_snapshot.task_defaults: Fields present on every source card may be shared once. Each task overrides the shared values.
progress_board_snapshot.validation: Reject v3 reads without nonempty object defaults or object task rows.
progress_board_snapshot.deployment_order: Deploy the consumer before the producer can publish v3.

prospect_engagement.history: Existing prospects and new prospects created over leads start active. Migration initialization is audited without changing board membership or client versions. Only an explicit partner engagement choice returns a prospect to Leads. Retain the existing client, lead links, deals and events. Suppression and archived stages remain protected.

progress_orchestrator.freshness: Queue events use the existing publisher. Scheduled GitHub and release refresh runs independently of a model. Page polling does not prove fresh upstream observations.

pagination.pages: Two reusable banks of stable page slots, CAS-written and verified before publishing the root manifest last. Local publishers share a host lock across checkouts.
pagination.counts: total_cards and state_counts include every unresolved item. cards is newest changes first.
pagination.unavailable: Version mismatches refuse mixed observations. Loaded older pages refresh together; page failure retains the complete displayed observation. Queue outage retains all previous queue pages.
pagination.legacy: Queue acknowledgement verifies this feed only. Scheduled carr-v5 publication can fail independently.

post_call_next_step_review.read: Loopback companion GET /api/post-call returns report.deal_updates[].next_step as null, omitted or an object with text, next_date, optional candidate_id and candidate_status.
post_call_next_step_review.write: Existing resolve-candidate through resolveConfirm. The nested candidate uses its own proposal_id and retained idempotency key. Confirming or skipping it never disposes the parent note.
post_call_next_step_review.review: Display the replacement text, exact date and disposition. A null next_date clears the current date. Only a pending proposal with a candidate_id offers Confirm next step and Skip next step.

call_outcomes.read: read-call-outcomes {} returns calls[] not yet reviewed: session_id, call_date, recorder, applied[] (candidate_id, kind next_step|phase_move, deal_id, deal_name, deal_version, payload, evidence_quote, applied_at, undone_at) and open_cards[] (candidate_id, resolver, kind, deal_id, deal_name, payload, evidence_quote). send is always false.
call_outcomes.write: undo-call-change {candidate_id, base_version} reverts one applied change; newer_change_exists and version conflicts are refusals to show, never retried. review-call-outcome {session_id} takes one call off Home.
call_outcomes.review: Show each applied change with what changed, its transcript quote and one Undo. Count open cards; they are decided in their own review lists.

instruct-deal-item.effect: Record a partner instruction for exactly one open deal item. This records a request and never claims the requested work was executed.

complete-deal-item.effect: Mark exactly one deal checklist item done. Other items, due dates, and the deal next_step stay unchanged.

record-deal-item.effect: Add one sourced deal checklist item. It never replaces sibling actions. Repeating source_ref and title returns the existing item.

email_proposals.read: list-email-proposals {deal?,limit,cursor?} filters pending proposals by the optional deal UUID before paging. Deal cursors must belong to that deal and remain valid after resolution. Deal filter producer: DoctorCRE/carr-system@5069155258335a44686086fcfa74ee8b7871c01a (#2477). It returns proposals oldest first, send:false, more and next_cursor. Paging producer: DoctorCRE/carr-system@81099219dff8270cee6be8150cfd00d7888437d3. Each proposal has id, version, kind, deal, deal_name, confidence, suspected_instruction, source, confirm_verb, preview and preview_error.
email_proposals.review: Display evidence as untrusted text and suspected_instruction as a warning. Sender role is not supplied; phase and next-step cards never display raw addresses or infer a role. Null preview remains dismissible. Reply drafts display the exact server-provided To/CC addresses before submission and retain them in the submission request.
email_proposals.confirmation: Joe only. Fetch and display a fresh matching preview before confirming the same fields plus its proposal_digest and a retained idempotency_key. Do not infer a digest or move a phase locally.
email_proposals.dismissal: Joe or Dell, exact observed version and a nonempty reason of at most 500 characters. Version conflicts require a fresh review.
email_proposals.deployment_order: Existing proposal verbs are live. Reply submission waits for the pinned producer PR #2522 to be live. No intake, router, outbox or sender write is consumed.

reply_drafts.read: carr-email-reply-draft.v1 at the pinned producer revision in PR #2522, not yet live. Pending reply_draft items carry reply_draft {subject,body,owner,to,cc}, status, null preview and confirm_verb submit-email-draft. to and cc each contain one exact routable address. Review displays those addresses before Submit. Missing source or copy addresses omit both arrays, set preview_error to email_draft_source_missing or email_draft_copy_address_missing and set confirm_verb:null. Keep that row readable and dismissible with reply review disabled.
reply_drafts.submission: Only the owning authenticated human partner can submit. Preserve exact text, displayed to/cc arrays, reviewed version and original idempotency key on uncertain retries. The server compares displayed recipients with the current captured sender and other partner actor.email and refuses email_draft_recipients_mismatch if they differ. That refusal and version_conflict require explicit fresh review, never automatic resubmission. A successful receipt has ok:true, proposal_id, status:approved_to_send, version, subject, body, sha256, to and cc matching the reviewed request. It queues sending on the partner Mac and does not confirm delivery.
reply_drafts.deployment_order: Hold deployment and auto-merge until server PR #2522 at the pinned revision is merged and live.

recent_outcomes.read: list-email-proposals {mode:recent_outcomes,limit:20,cursor?}. No status argument. The producer defaults limit to 20 with maximum 50. Authenticated partner scope matches proposal owner and captured mailbox owner. Optional deal UUID restricts results; Home reads across deals.
recent_outcomes.ordering: Recorded sent/failed outcomes only, result_recorded_at descending then proposal id descending. Historical null result timestamps are excluded. The recorded time is not submission time or recipient delivery time.
recent_outcomes.pagination: Response includes proposals, send:false, more and next_cursor. Cursor is the last returned proposal UUID when more is true, null otherwise. Pass the cursor to request one additional bounded page. The cursor must identify a matching outcome in the same partner/deal scope.
recent_outcomes.pending: Use the existing list-email-proposals {status:approved_to_send,limit:20,cursor?} read, which returns email-proposals.v1 in creation order oldest first. Home filters reply_draft.owner against the verified signed-in partner and displays submitted_email.subject with pending delivery wording. The recent mode does not include pending replies. Each stream pages only on request; a filtered pending page may have no matching rows and more:true.
recent_outcomes.privacy: Recent outcomes contain no body, recipients, addresses or free-text failure reason. Home projects only subject, deal, status, recorded time and allowlisted reason labels; it never renders pending body or addresses. Team scope does not broaden reply delivery. Session loss or identity change clears retained rows and fences in-flight reads.
recent_outcomes.deployment_order: Do not enable auto-merge. Production must serve server PR #2608 at the pinned merged revision before the orchestrator merges this consumer.

filing.read: file_to_deal and possible_new_deal carry email-filing.v1 previews with proposal_id, kind, deal, activity_id, evidence_quote, sender, sender_role, new_people, text and proposal_digest. A possible new deal has a null deal. Unknown kinds are ignored.
filing.confirmation: Joe or Dell confirms with confirm-email-filing {proposal_id,base_version,proposal_digest,idempotency_key,deal?}. A possible new deal supplies the ID returned by new-deal. Show public refusal hints.
filing.deployment_order: Deploy this consumer before producer PR #2503. Current producer responses remain supported.

non_deal_next_steps.read: Home calls list-email-proposals with include_non_deal=true. Non-deal next_step rows have deal=null and subject_type, subject_id and subject_name matching their preview. Deal pages keep their existing deal filter.
non_deal_next_steps.confirmation: Reuse preview-email-next-step and confirm-email-next-step with deal=null, the exact activity, quote, text, date, owner and fresh digest. Show the affected contact and replacement action before confirmation. Joe alone confirms. Null previews remain dismissible.
non_deal_next_steps.deployment_order: Merge and verify the pinned server producer before merging this consumer. Do not auto-merge this app change.

email_thread_filings.read: list-email-thread-filings {} returns {filings} for the authenticated partner. The app shows only subject and sender_name (null shows as unavailable), never summary, addresses or ids. activity_version is the server guard and is null for legacy events; never infer missing fields.

read_fields.event_id: Filing event UUID, supplied to undo
read_fields.subject: Source email subject, null when unavailable
read_fields.sender_name: Source email sender display name, null when unavailable
read_fields.occurred_at: Source email timestamp; falls back to filing time when intake did not pass the email time
read_fields.activity_version: Activity version recorded at filing, null for legacy events

email_thread_filings.undo: undo-email-thread-filing {event_id,idempotency_key} with a new UUID key per attempt. Refusals such as email_thread_filing_changed leave the filing intact and are shown, never retried.
email_thread_filings.deployment_order: The app must not merge before the producer PR is deployed.
